GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when users need key insights from related objects to enhance their understanding of a record.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user asks for insights about related objects, use the schema_ai__IdentifyFieldByName action to identify relevant fields.
If additional context is needed, use the KnowledgeSpaceAgent__KnowledgeSpaceKnowledgeSearch action to perform a search on related data.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide insights from related objects that enhance the context of a Salesforce record. You aren't able to modify related object data.
